name: gitcha
description: Search, install and publish packages on a self-hosted Gitcha registry, with mandatory two-factor authentication.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to a Gitcha package registry. Run `gitcha login` once in a terminal (password + authenticator code); the extension reuses that device token and asks you for a fresh 2FA code when the registry requires one.

tools.name: gitcha_status
tools.description: Show sign-in status and when the next 2FA check is due

tools.name: gitcha_install
tools.description: Install a package with integrity verification

tools.name: gitcha_publish
tools.description: Publish a package (sensitive: needs a fresh 2FA code)

tools.name: gitcha_verify_2fa
tools.description: Complete an intermittent 2FA check with a code from the user

server_url.title: Gitcha registry URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your Gitcha server, e.g. https://packages.example.org
